stemMd: How does the graph of y=2 to the power −x relate to y=2 to the power x?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It is reflected in the x-axis.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It is rotated arbitrarily by 90 degrees.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It is reflected in the y-axis.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It is identical at every x.

explanationMd: Replacing the input x with −x reverses left and right, giving reflection across the y-axis. Outputs remain positive, so it is not an x-axis reflection.

distractorRationale.b: Replacing x by −x has a specific reflection effect.
distractorRationale.e: They coincide at x=0 but differ elsewhere.
distractorRationale.a: That would negate the output, not the input.
distractorRationale.c: No constant is added outside the power.
